blinding: Reviewer saw public list counts during extraction; assessments reasoned from full task text, not independently blinded evaluation.

reviews.solution_rationale: Simulate the stated parity rule using 64-bit integers; no algorithm discovery beyond translating the process.
Handle n=2,3 as impossible; output evens then odds for n>=4, with n=1 separate. Verify the boundary difference.
Backtrack the 48 moves while marking cells; reject premature destination and local configurations that split remaining free cells. Pruning correctness and runtime are the challenge.
reviews.complexity: Exponential search on fixed 7x7 board, heavily pruned

reviews.solution_rationale: Require a+b<=n and either both scores zero or both positive. Leave ties fixed and cyclically shift the remaining a+b ordered cards to realize exactly a and b wins.
Maintain seen row/column values and simulate mex for each cell; n<=100 permits cubic work, so XOR recognition is optional.
Scan row-major and select a character avoiding the old value and assigned upper/left neighbors. At most three of four characters are forbidden.
Sort coins and maintain the contiguous representable prefix [0,s]. A next coin >s+1 exposes the first gap; otherwise extend by its value.
Store inverse permutation and number of descents between consecutive values. A swap only changes neighbor-value pairs touching its two values; deduplicate affected pairs.
Sort intervals by left ascending/right descending; compressed right endpoints and two Fenwick sweeps count containment in each direction.
Process movies by finish time; assign each to the member with latest available end <= start using an ordered multiset. Exchange argument preserves capacity.
Prefix sums turn each answer into current prefix minus minimum over eligible starting prefixes. Maintain that sliding minimum with a deque.
For each distinct value choose either no occurrence or exactly one of its frequency occurrences; multiply (frequency+1), then exclude the empty choice.
Two frontier states distinguish whether width-two boundary is joined or split; derive transitions (2a+b, a+4b), precompute through max n.
Keep only frontier cells yielding the smallest next letter on each anti-diagonal. Deduplicate the next frontier so every grid cell is processed a constant number of times.

Compute strict greater-or-equal blockers using monotone stacks. Process heights in increasing batches and query range maxima between blockers; defer equal-height updates to prevent invalid transitions.
Profile DP over the short dimension with a bitmask of incoming horizontal dominoes; recursively enumerate compatible fillings and transfer masks column by column.
reviews.complexity: O(m * number of compatible profile transitions), at most O(m*4^n)

reviews.solution_rationale: Digit DP counts valid numbers <=bound using previous digit, tightness, and leading-zero state; subtract counts at a-1 and handle zero consistently.
Coordinate-compress values; dp at an element is one plus the sum for strictly smaller values in a Fenwick tree. Accumulate position-distinct subsequences.
Multi-source BFS gives earliest monster arrivals; player BFS accepts a cell only strictly before monsters and stores predecessors for an escape path.
Negate scores and use Bellman-Ford; only a relaxable cycle reachable from start and able to reach destination makes the score unbounded.
Decompose the functional graph into cycles and in-trees. Use component IDs, depth, cycle index, and binary lifting to distinguish reachable tree ancestors from cycle destinations.
Translate each disjunction into two implications and run SCC. Contradictory literals in one SCC are impossible; condensation order yields an assignment.
Represent (n-1)-bit suffixes as vertices and n-bit words as edges; an Euler circuit emits every word once, attaining length 2^n+n-1. Special-case n=1.
Unit-capacity maximum flow gives edge-disjoint route count; decompose positive flow into source-sink paths while handling residual edges and possible cycles.
reviews.complexity: O(m * maxflow) with unit augmenting paths; maxflow<=m

reviews.solution_rationale: Build 64-bit prefix sums and answer each inclusive range by subtraction.
Next strictly greater building links are found by a monotone stack. Binary lifting counts successors while their indices remain <=query right endpoint.

Build persistent segment trees of value sums for index prefixes. Repeatedly query range sum of coin values <=current covered sum+1 until the first unreachable value stabilizes; justify growth to bound iterations.
reviews.complexity: O((n+q log S) log V), S total sum and V distinct values

reviews.solution_rationale: First DFS computes subtree sizes and root distance sum; reroot via answer[child]=answer[parent]+n-2*size[child]. Use 64-bit totals.
Heavy-light decomposition maps a tree path to logarithmically many array intervals; a max segment tree supports point updates and path maxima.
Centroid decomposition counts pairs of depths in [k1,k2] at each centroid; subtract same-child contributions and count sorted depth pairs with two pointers.
reviews.complexity: O(n log^2 n) with sorted depths; optimized depth counting can improve

reviews.solution_rationale: Binary exponentiation under a prime modulus; exponent zero returns one, including the stipulated 0^0 case.
Test successive candidates with deterministic Miller-Rabin bases valid through 10^12, using safe modular multiplication; alternatively pre-sieve primes for trial division.
reviews.complexity: O(candidate gap * fixed bases * log n)

reviews.solution_rationale: Gaussian elimination over the prime field with modular inverses, pivot selection, rank and inconsistency checks; set free variables to zero.
Compute KMP prefix function and follow border links from the final position; reverse the resulting chain for increasing output.
Build a palindromic tree online; its current longest suffix palindrome gives the longest palindrome ending at each position. Requires suffix links and sentinel roots.
reviews.complexity: O(n * alphabet) worst case with fixed alphabet transitions

reviews.solution_rationale: A suffix automaton accumulates occurrence counts via length order. Each transition contributes child occurrences plus descendant weights; traverse lexicographically subtracting weights to find kth substring including multiplicity.
Sign of the cross product determines orientation; use sufficiently wide intermediate arithmetic for coordinate differences.
A Li Chao segment tree inserts each line only over its active segment. Range insertion plus line comparison recursions add an extra log factor; query along one root-to-leaf path.
Sweep rectangle x-events with a compressed-y segment tree tracking cover counts and covered length. Area increment is covered y length times delta x.
Reverse topological DP unions successor bitsets and includes the node itself. Scalar reachability counts cannot account for overlapping reachable sets.
Precompute weighted-median interval service costs, then partition houses with k-stage DP. Prove monotone optimal split positions to use divide-and-conquer optimization.
Convert each edge lifetime into segment-tree-over-time intervals; traverse with rollback DSU and report component count at leaves. Avoid path compression unless rollback accounts for it.
Generate values and maintain a rolling 64-bit sum, removing the outgoing value and XORing each complete window sum.
Maintain value frequencies and an ordered set keyed by negative frequency then value; update entering/leaving elements and read the first key.

For each bar find its maximal interval of heights >=its height. Over window starts containing that bar, its possible rectangle area is height times the intersection length, a constant number of affine pieces. Insert those pieces in a segment Li Chao tree and query maxima.
reviews.complexity: O(n log^2 n); implementation runtime requires verification

reviews.solution_rationale: Binary search the hidden integer with the strict less-than oracle. Maintain inclusive bounds, flush every query, and stop after at most 30 comparisons.
Compare chair colors after XOR with index parity. The cyclic endpoints 1 and n+1 have opposite transformed values because n is odd; bisect an interval with unequal endpoints until adjacent.

Maintain a sorted prefix. Reverse prefix of length k and use inversion-count difference to infer rank of its last value, reverse back, then rotate that last value into its rank with two reversals. Include one no-op initial query; total <=4n.
Insert each value into a GF(2) basis by highest set bit. Greedily XOR basis vectors from high to low when they improve the answer.
Reduce an XOR basis into ordered pivot form to enumerate increasing distinct XORs by binary coefficients. Each distinct XOR occurs 2^(n-rank) times; cap that multiplicity at k to avoid overflow.
Superset zeta transform gives counts of values containing each mask. Apply 2^count-1, then superset Mobius inversion to obtain exact AND frequencies.

Greedily assign allowed unused values until four positions remain; only two values are forbidden per position. Brute-force the final four. The residual bipartite graph has minimum degree at least two on both sides, sufficient for a perfect matching at size four.
reviews.complexity: O(n log n), constant final enumeration

reviews.solution_rationale: Use area divisibility and exclude unit-width boards and 3-by-odd boards. Decompose feasible boards into 2x3, 3x2 and 5x9 templates; color neighboring trominos differently. Nontrivial odd-dimension construction is essential.

Rectangle Hamiltonian-path construction requires checkerboard feasibility plus exceptional thin-grid endpoint conditions, followed by recursive strip splitting and base constructions. Full case proof and implementation remain for specialist adjudication; no simple snake assumption is valid.
reviews.complexity: Polynomial constructive algorithm; exact bound requires specialist verification

reviews.solution_rationale: Run Kruskal by weight. For each query's equal-weight edges test acyclicity on components formed by strictly smaller edges with temporary DSU/rollback, then permanently merge the entire weight group.

Build the block-cut tree using lowlinks; a forbidden articulation separates endpoints precisely when its tree node lies on their block-cut path. LCA answers path membership; endpoint-equals-forbidden cases are immediate.

Condense SCCs and pair reachable source/sink components to construct a cycle, then attach unmatched sources and sinks. Count is max(number of sources,number of sinks), but arbitrary enumeration can produce disconnected cycles.
reviews.complexity: O(n+m) with careful source-sink traversal; construction proof needs independent checking

reviews.solution_rationale: For each row maintain vertical same-letter run heights. Within maximal equal-letter horizontal runs, a monotone stack sums minimum heights of all ending intervals, accumulating the corresponding letter's rectangle count.

View A and B as partial permutations. Inclusion-exclusion chooses coincident rows in three categories: both entries free, only A free, only B free. Shared free columns supply the both-free coincidences; factorials complete the remaining entries.
reviews.complexity: O(n^3) direct summation; separable inner sums permit O(n^2)

reviews.solution_rationale: Rounds equal one plus descents of the inverse permutation, so their distribution is Eulerian numbers. Insert the largest value to obtain A(n,k)=k*A(n-1,k)+(n-k+1)*A(n-1,k-1).
Subtract observed values from n(n+1)/2 using wide integers.
Scan runs of equal characters and track the longest run.
Track prefix maximum and add each deficit below it; lowering earlier values is forbidden.
Determine square layer max(x,y); its parity determines whether row or column runs backward. Use square endpoints with 64-bit arithmetic.
Count all pairs of squares then subtract four attacking pairs per 2-by-3 placement.
Odd total sum is impossible; otherwise greedily take largest remaining values until half is reached, leaving the complement.
Count independent binary choices as 2^n modulo the modulus; repeated doubling suffices at n<=10^6.
Count factors of five in n! by summing floor(n/5^k); twos are abundant.
Solve for nonnegative move counts: total divisible by three and larger pile at most twice smaller.
Frequency parity permits at most one odd count; place half counts and mirror around an optional center.
Reflected binary Gray codes, equivalently i XOR (i>>1), change exactly one bit per adjacent index.
Recursively move n-1 to spare, move largest, then move n-1 to destination; 2^n-1 is necessary.
Sort characters and repeatedly enumerate next lexicographic permutation; duplicate letters naturally produce unique strings.
Enumerate subsets because n<=20; minimize absolute total minus twice selected weight.
Backtrack one queen per row with column and diagonal occupancy; reserved squares are simply skipped.
reviews.complexity: O(8!) states up to fixed factors

reviews.solution_rationale: BFS from the corner over eight knight moves gives all minimum distances.
Skip blocks of equal digit length, locate the containing integer by quotient, and the digit by remainder. Handle 1-based boundaries and 10^18 arithmetic.

Build lexicographically by choosing the smallest nonprevious letter that leaves a feasible remaining multiset. A majority at the maximum admissible count forces that letter; otherwise smallest available is safe.
Sort and count transitions or insert into a set.
Sort desired sizes and apartments; two pointers match compatible smallest remaining pair, otherwise advance the too-small side.
Sort weights and pair the heaviest remaining with the lightest when feasible; otherwise send heaviest alone.
Ordered multiset predecessor lookup gives the highest price within budget, then delete one occurrence.
Sort arrival/departure events and take the maximum running occupancy; all event times distinct.
Greedily select compatible movies in increasing finish order, justified by exchange of the first chosen movie.
Scan with a map of previously seen values to find the complement, retaining distinct positions.
Kadane DP tracks the best nonempty subarray ending here; initialize from the first value for all-negative arrays.
A median minimizes sum of absolute deviations; sort or select the median then sum wide differences.
Build inverse positions; each descent pos[v]>pos[v+1] starts another collection round.
A sliding window plus last occurrence advances its left bound past any duplicate.
Replace the smallest tower top strictly greater than each incoming cube using upper_bound; otherwise start a new tower.
Ordered light positions locate the split interval; a multiset of gap lengths removes one old gap and inserts two new gaps.
Maintain the longest distinct suffix with last occurrences; add its length to the total for each right endpoint.
Simulate alternating rotation/removal in a deque; each child is removed after constant amortized queue work.
Maintain alive ranks in a Fenwick/order-statistics tree; modularly advance by k then remove the selected rank.
Sort by left ascending/right descending; prefix maximum and suffix minimum right endpoints detect containing and contained intervals.
Process arrivals with a heap of departure times and room IDs; reuse only a room whose departure is strictly earlier.
Binary search elapsed time; production is sum floor(time/machine_time), capped at target to avoid overflow.
Deadlines add a constant; minimize total completion time by sorting durations ascending using adjacent-swap argument.
Minimum makespan is max(total duration, twice maximum duration); these two lower bounds are jointly achievable.
Sort indexed values, fix one position, and use two pointers for the remaining sum.
Scan middle split and query sums of earlier index pairs against later pairs; deferred insertion ensures four distinct indices.
Monotone increasing stack discards values that cannot be the nearest smaller predecessor.
Positive values make window sum monotone; advance left while too large and count equality.
Count prior prefix sums equal to current prefix minus target; seed empty prefix and support negatives.
Equal normalized prefix residues mod n form divisible subarrays; count residue pairs using wide totals.
Frequency-map window keeps at most k distinct values; all suffixes inside its valid left bound contribute.
Binary search maximum permitted sum; greedily pack positive values and test whether at most k segments suffice.
One-dimensional count DP sums previous six states, starting dp[0]=1.
Unbounded coin DP minimizes one plus a reachable predecessor; greedy denominations are not valid generally.
Sum-first DP counts ordered sequences, adding each possible last coin.
Coin-first increasing-sum DP counts each multiset once despite ambiguous use of ordered in the statement.
DP over values tries subtracting each nonzero decimal digit; earlier values suffice.
Grid DP adds upper and left counts unless blocked; handle blocked endpoints.
0/1 knapsack by price; descending budget updates prevent buying a book twice.
DP by index and last value, summing three neighboring previous values and respecting fixed entries.
Prefix edit-distance DP compares match/substitution, deletion, insertion; rolling rows reduce memory.
LCS prefix DP with reconstruction chooses diagonal on equality or a larger neighboring state otherwise.
DP by rectangle dimensions tries every horizontal and vertical split; squares cost zero.
Subset-sum bitset or descending boolean DP enumerates reachable positive totals after each coin.
reviews.complexity: O(n*sum values), faster with word bitsets

reviews.solution_rationale: Interval minimax DP stores score difference; choose left minus opponent state or right minus opponent state, then recover score from total.
Subset-sum counting at half total; avoid double counting complementary groups by excluding n from the selectable set or divide by two mod prime.
Maintain minimum tail for every LIS length and replace lower_bound of each value for strict increase.
Weighted interval scheduling sorted by finish; binary search latest strictly earlier finish and take max(skip,reward+compatible best).
Subset DP keeps lexicographically minimal pair (rides,last ride weight); adding each person either fits or starts a ride.
Flood-fill each unseen floor component; iterative traversal avoids stack overflow on a million cells.
BFS with predecessor direction reconstructs a shortest grid path.
Find connected components and link one representative of each in a chain; components-1 is optimal.
BFS in an unweighted graph with predecessor reconstruction produces shortest route.
Two-color every connected component using BFS/DFS and reject same-color adjacent vertices.
Undirected DFS tracks parent and active ancestors; a nonparent back edge reconstructs a simple cycle.
Positive edge costs permit Dijkstra with a min-heap; discard stale entries and use 64-bit distances.
Floyd-Warshall over n<=500 computes all-pairs distances; retain minimum parallel edge and guard infinity.
Run Dijkstra from source and on reversed graph from destination; minimize distSource[a]+floor(c/2)+distTarget[b] over edges.
Initialize all distances to zero for a virtual super-source; Bellman-Ford relaxation in round n identifies a cycle. Walk predecessors n steps before reconstructing.
Modified Dijkstra permits each node to be popped at most k times, retaining duplicate path costs; positive weights order routes.
Three-color directed DFS finds an edge to an active ancestor; reconstruct via parent pointers.
Kahn topological ordering removes zero-indegree vertices; fewer than n output vertices indicates a cycle.
Topological DP maximizes reachable path length from node 1 and stores predecessors for reconstruction.
Topological DP propagates modular path counts from node 1.
Dijkstra carries route count and min/max edge counts; replace metadata on shorter paths and merge on equal distances. Strictly positive edges ensure predecessors finalize earlier.
Binary lifting stores successors after powers of two; decompose k into bits.
Peel indegree-zero nodes to isolate cycles, measure cycle lengths, then propagate distance-to-cycle plus cycle length in reverse removal order.
Kruskal sorts costs and joins DSU components; verify n-1 accepted edges and use wide total cost.
DSU with component sizes tracks component count and maximum size after each union.
Traverse from one root in graph and reverse graph; missing reachability provides an explicit offending pair.
Kosaraju or Tarjan SCC labels mutually reachable vertices.
Collapse SCCs, summing each component's positive coins; longest weighted path DP on the condensation DAG.
Check even degrees then Hierholzer from vertex 1 using edge IDs; verify all m edges were used.
Check directed Euler-path degree imbalances at 1 and n, run Hierholzer, and verify full edge coverage and endpoints.
Subset DP indexed by visited mask and final vertex counts Hamiltonian paths; reserve destination until the complete mask and preserve edge multiplicities.
Backtrack knight moves ordered by onward degree (Warnsdorff) with full undo; fixed 8x8 board permits this constructive heuristic, but exhaustive correctness is from fallback search.
reviews.complexity: Exponential worst case on fixed 64-cell board

reviews.solution_rationale: Model directed capacities and compute maximum flow with residual reverse edges using Dinic.
Unit-capacity undirected max flow; vertices reachable in final residual graph define a minimum cut whose original crossing edges are printed.
Bipartite augmenting-path matching stores each girl's partner and reroutes existing pairs; reconstruct matched edges.
Sparse table or segment tree supports static range minima; idempotence allows overlapping power-of-two blocks.
Fenwick sums plus stored old values convert assignments into delta updates.
Segment-tree minima support point assignments and range queries.
Prefix XOR cancels values before the requested interval.
Difference-array Fenwick: add at a and subtract at b+1; point value is its prefix sum.
Two-dimensional prefix counts answer rectangles with four-corner inclusion-exclusion.
Segment-tree maxima let each request descend left whenever that child has sufficient capacity; update the chosen leaf.
Fenwick alive counts and binary lifting select the kth surviving position, then decrement its count.
Read queries offline to compress all salary values; Fenwick frequencies support replacement and inclusive salary-range counts.
Segment nodes store total sum and maximum prefix; ordered merge is max(left.prefix,left.sum+right.prefix).
Maintain range minima of price-index on the left and price+index on the right; add/subtract the query position.
Process queries as signed prefix-count events by index, using a Fenwick tree over compressed values to count the requested value range.
Segment tree stores total, maximum prefix, maximum suffix, and maximum subarray; merge crossing suffix+prefix and permit zero.
Use ordered segment-tree aggregates (sum,prefix,suffix,best) over each query interval.
Offline sweep by right endpoint keeps a one only at each value's most recent occurrence; Fenwick range sum counts distinct values.
Store previous equal position per index and range maximum thereof. Ordered occurrence sets update only adjacent same-value links after replacement; distinct iff maxPrev in [a,b]<a.
Sweep left endpoints backward; monotone stack identifies ranges whose running maximum changes, and lazy range assignment plus original prefix sums answers increment costs.
Precompute earliest-finishing compatible next movie for each time, then binary-lift greedy transitions to maximize movies ending within the query interval.
Two-dimensional Fenwick tree supports cell toggle deltas and rectangle sums by four prefix queries.
Lazy segment tree composes assignment and addition in temporal order; assignment replaces prior lazy updates, addition adjusts assigned value or additive tag.
Represent each progression update as an affine function of global index; segment sums use count and index sum with lazy slope/intercept tags.
Persistent segment tree path-copies on update, clones roots in O(1), and retains separate array root identities.
reviews.complexity: O(n+q log n) time and memory

reviews.solution_rationale: Postorder subtree sizes minus one give subordinate counts.
Tree DP distinguishes whether a node is matched to a child; compare replacing one child's unmatched contribution by a matched edge.
Two farthest-node traversals find a tree diameter.
Find both diameter endpoints; each node's eccentricity is max of its distances to those endpoints.
Binary lifting handles kth ancestors, with absent-ancestor sentinel propagation.
Equalize depths and lift both nodes from highest power down to find LCA.
Preprocess depths and LCA, then answer depth[a]+depth[b]-2*depth[lca].
Tree difference updates +1 at endpoints, -1 at LCA and its parent; postorder accumulation counts vertex participation.
Euler-tour subtree intervals reduce to point updates and Fenwick range sums.
Changing a node adds a delta to root-path sums of its entire subtree; Euler flattening with range-add point-query Fenwick gives answers.
Euler-flatten subtrees and use offline last-occurrence Fenwick distinct counts, or small-to-large set merging.
Compute subtree sizes; find a vertex whose child subtrees and complement are each at most n/2.
Centroid decomposition counts cross-child depth pairs totaling k, adding each child's frequencies only after its queries.
Recursively remove the first round of even positions and map the remaining odd labels back, handling odd-n rotation.
Reduce exponent b^c modulo p-1 for nonzero a, then exponentiate modulo p. Separately handle a=0 and true exponent zero.
Sieve divisor counts by incrementing every multiple of each divisor.
Frequency sieve scans candidate gcds downward and counts values divisible by each; first with at least two occurrences is maximal.
Swap summation to sum d*floor(n/d), then group intervals with equal quotient using arithmetic-series sums modulo p.
Prime exponent formulas give divisor count/geometric sums. Update divisor product using previous count modulo p-1 and p powers; distinguish modulus for exponents.
Inclusion-exclusion over prime subsets adds/subtracts floor(n/product); guard multiplication by comparing against n/factor.
Sieve multiples to count divisible elements; Mobius-weighted pair counts isolate gcd one.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials modulo the prime; each binomial is three factors.
Multinomial count n! divided by frequency factorials via modular inverses.
Stars-and-bars gives choose(n+m-1,n-1), evaluated with factorials modulo prime.
Derangements recurrence D[n]=(n-1)(D[n-1]+D[n-2]) with D[0]=1,D[1]=0.
Factoradic rank/unrank: count unused smaller values for each position, or select quotient-th unused value. 20! fits signed 64-bit.
Permutation cycles give return period as their LCM; retain maximal prime exponents of cycle lengths and multiply modulo p.
Odd lengths impossible; Catalan count choose(n,n/2)/(n/2+1) modulo prime.
Reject negative prefix balance or excess opens; reflection principle counts suffix walks from current balance to zero without dropping negative.
Burnside over rotations counts m^gcd(n,shift); group shifts by gcd/divisors using Euler phi if desired and divide by n modulo p.
reviews.complexity: O(n log n) direct rotation summation

reviews.solution_rationale: Burnside over four rotations; derive fixed-cell orbit counts for 90/180 degrees, including odd central cell, then divide by four.
Fast doubling or 2x2 matrix exponentiation evaluates enormous Fibonacci index modulo p.
Six-state linear recurrence for dice-sum counts is exponentiated as a 6x6 transition matrix.
Raise adjacency-count matrix to kth power under modular sum-product; preserve parallel edges.
Matrix exponentiation over min-plus semiring gives minimum weight using exactly k edges; infinity guards and zero diagonal identity matter.
Precompute representations of sums of two squares up to n; enumerate one represented pair-sum and look up its complement. Total n across tests bounds work.
reviews.complexity: O(n) pair enumeration per test, O(n) memory

reviews.solution_rationale: Gauss guarantees at most three triangular numbers. Check one by discriminant square, then two by a two-pointer sweep over triangular numbers up to n; otherwise three.
Probability DP over dice count and sum adds six equally likely predecessor outcomes; sum desired interval and format rounding.
Propagate each starting robot's distribution independently. Empty probability of each square is product of nonarrival probabilities; sum by linearity of expectation.
CDF of maximum is (v/k)^n; sum tail probabilities over v=0..k-1 for expectation, using sufficient numerical precision.
Linearity of expectation sums probability x_i>x_j for every pair, computed by enumeration or arithmetic sums; independence enables pairwise calculation.
Winning-state DP checks whether any allowed removal reaches a losing state.
Classic Nim XOR invariant: nonzero XOR is winning.
Each heap's Grundy value is size modulo four; XOR those values across heaps.
XOR counts on even-numbered stairs. Moves from odd stairs can be mirrored; even stairs act as Nim heaps.

Compute Grundy mex of unequal splits for small heaps and exploit the known finite losing-position behavior within the 10^6 bound. The cutoff needs verified exhaustive evidence, not guessed extrapolation.
reviews.complexity: Specialist verification required for bounded-domain cutoff

reviews.solution_rationale: All-even heaps are losing; otherwise remove one from each odd heap to leave all-even. Any move from all-even creates an odd heap.
Trie dictionary traversal from each reachable string position feeds word-break counting DP; n<=5000 permits quadratic character traversal.
KMP prefix function scans text and counts overlapping matches in linear time.
Z-function verifies candidate period i when z[i]>=n-i; full length always qualifies.
Booth/two-candidate minimum-rotation algorithm skips dominated starts in doubled string using matched-prefix lengths.
Manacher maintains odd/even palindrome radii using mirrored bounds and expansion.
KMP prefix automaton DP counts length-n strings avoiding a full match; subtract from 26^n. Full-match transitions are excluded.
Segment trees/Fenwick rolling hashes compare normalized forward and reverse range hashes with updates; collision handling requires multiple moduli.
Aho-Corasick automaton scans text then propagates reached-state occurrence flags along failure links.
Aho-Corasick counts visited states, then reverse failure-tree propagation yields all pattern frequencies without enumerating every match.
Aho-Corasick records earliest ending position per state and propagates minima through failure links; subtract pattern length to obtain first start.
Suffix array plus LCP subtracts shared prefixes from total substrings, or suffix automaton sums len-link.len.
Distinct subsequence DP doubles previous count then subtracts duplicates introduced by the same last character; subtract the empty subsequence, matching example 103.
Longest adjacent LCP in a suffix array gives longest repeated substring, allowing overlaps.
Implement both linear Z-window algorithm and KMP prefix-function fallback recurrence; set first values to zero.
Given suffix ranks, assign letters along suffix order; increase letter exactly when following-position ranks decrease. Empty suffix has smallest rank; >26 groups impossible.
Invert Burrows-Wheeler using stable occurrence ranks (LF mapping) between last column and sorted first column, starting at sentinel.
Suffix array and LCP partition new distinct substrings by suffix; subtract each suffix's n-start-LCP contribution to locate kth.
Each suffix-automaton state contributes one distinct substring for every length in (link.len,len]; difference-array add these intervals.
Orientation tests plus collinear bounding-box overlap handle proper intersections, endpoints, and overlapping segments with wide arithmetic.
Shoelace cross-product sum gives twice signed polygon area; print absolute value with sufficiently wide accumulator.
Check boundary collinearity first; half-open ray-crossing convention avoids double-counting vertices, using exact integer orientations.
Boundary lattice count is sum gcd(abs dx,abs dy); Pick's theorem with shoelace area gives interior count.
Closest-pair divide-and-conquer merges y-sorted halves and checks only nearby points in the width-d strip; preserve squared integer distances.
Monotone chain with appropriate strict-turn test retains all collinear boundary points; deduplicate concatenated endpoints.
Track extrema of x+y and x-y; maximum Manhattan distance is largest projection range.
Sort x and y independently; prefix sums accumulate each coordinate's pairwise absolute differences.
Sweep x, activate horizontal segments in a Fenwick over y, and range-count at each vertical segment.
Sort slopes, remove dominated equal slopes, construct upper convex hull, then process increasing x with a moving optimum pointer.
Segment Li Chao tree inserts each affine line only across its segment's x interval, then queries every integer coordinate.
Li Chao tree over fixed integer x-domain supports arbitrary-order line insertions and maximum queries.

Binary search the first self-intersecting path prefix using sweep-line segment intersection, including collinear overlap and excluding only adjacent shared endpoints; locate distance along the final segment.
reviews.complexity: O(n log^2 n), intricate endpoint cases

reviews.solution_rationale: Enumerate subset sums of two halves, sort one side and count complementary multiplicities.
Pack each <=30-bit string into an integer; all pairs use XOR and hardware popcount. Runtime is sensitive to optimized popcount at 2e4 strings.
For each letter record column pairs seen in a row; a repeated pair forms four equal corners. Stop once found, bounding pair processing by O(n^2) per letter.
Represent each row as a bitset; for every pair of rows count common black columns c and add choose(c,2).
Condense SCCs then union reachability bitsets on the DAG in reverse topological order; answer using component bits.
Implicit treap split by rank isolates the cut range; merge prefix and suffix followed by cut piece.
Implicit treap with lazy reversal isolates each substring by splits and toggles child order.
Implicit treap stores subtree sizes/sums plus lazy reversal; split by rank for reversal or range sum, then remerge.
DFS lowlinks identify bridges where low[child]>tin[parent].
DFS lowlinks identify articulation vertices, with root-child-count exception.
Even-degree subgraphs form the binary cycle space of dimension m-n+components; answer 2 to that power.
DP transition is a line query dp[j]+f[j]*s[i]. Monotone slopes and x allow deque convex-hull optimization.
Same DP line formulation but arbitrary slopes/query order require Li Chao or dynamic convex hull.
Expand squared prefix-sum differences into linear functions per DP layer; monotone prefix sums enable convex-hull optimization.
Interval merge DP has additive interval cost satisfying Knuth conditions; restrict optimal split to neighboring optimal ranges.
Convolve apple and banana frequency arrays via FFT/NTT, ensuring exact coefficients can exceed one modulus.
Convolve binary indicator array with its reverse; offset coefficients count one-bit pairs at each distance.
Reverse the mask then convolve with signal using FFT/NTT; coefficient order matches sliding overlap.
Build the chronological union reconstruction forest; LCA time is the first connection day, with same-node day zero and disconnected -1.
Min-cost flow sends k units with residual reverse costs, using potentials and shortest augmenting paths; reject insufficient total capacity.
reviews.complexity: O(k m log n) after valid potentials

reviews.solution_rationale: Hungarian assignment algorithm finds minimum cost perfect matching and reconstructs task partners.
Unit-capacity unit-cost min-cost flow sends exactly k units, then decompose final positive flow into routes.
reviews.complexity: O(k m log n) with potentials plus decomposition

reviews.solution_rationale: Generate values and maintain an increasing index deque; expire outside-window indices and XOR each front minimum.
Maintain window XOR by XORing entering and outgoing values, then XOR results; occurrence parity also permits streaming contribution counting.
A two-stack aggregate queue maintains bitwise OR with amortized constant work; pop from outgoing stack or transfer when empty.
Frequency map adjusts distinct count when entering/leaving values cross zero.
Only values 0..k can be mex candidates; maintain frequencies and an ordered set of absent candidates.
Two balanced multisets maintain lower half with ceil(k/2) elements; its maximum is the required lower median.
Extend two-multiset median maintenance with half sums; median minimizes absolute deviation and gives cost in constant time.
Fenwick frequencies count prior greater elements on insertion and remaining smaller elements on removal; update inversion total.
Comparison merge sort of indices uses fewer than 10000 oracle comparisons for n<=1000; invert sorted index order to recover values.
Binary search partition of two sorted score lists selecting k total elements; oracle comparisons at partition boundaries certify kth. Cache queries and use sentinels outside bounds.
Query ten bit planes encoding each original index; returned bit columns reconstruct its permuted index.
reviews.complexity: O(log n) queries and O(n log n) processing

reviews.solution_rationale: Each bit has periodic zero/one blocks; count full blocks and remaining ones for every position.
Prefix XOR turns subarray XOR into two-prefix XOR; a binary trie greedily selects opposite high bits.
Gaussian elimination over GF(2) computes basis rank; distinct subset XORs equal 2^rank.
Count prefix XOR frequencies and XOR-convolve them with Walsh-Hadamard transform. Positive nonzero coefficients indicate realizable subarray XOR; zero needs a repeated prefix, not self-pairs.
Top coefficients are binomial(n-1,i) modulo two; Lucas parity includes precisely indices that are submasks of n-1.
Left diagonal entry k is XOR of a[i] over submasks i of k; perform subset zeta transform with XOR on zero-padded power-of-two length.
Apply (I+shift)^(n-k) over GF(2); each set bit in the exponent combines values separated by that power of two.
Subset and superset zeta transforms answer first two predicates; nonzero AND count is n minus subset count of the complement mask.
Choose largest remaining value when k can pay remaining_count-1 inversions; otherwise place the value giving exactly residual k and finish sorted.
Erdos-Szekeres implies n<=k^2; construct increasing blocks of descending values with block size<=k and exactly k maximum monotone length.
Find prime p strictly above current maximum n, pair interval [p-n,n] in reverse so sums are p, then recurse on smaller prefix. Bertrand's bound keeps indices valid.
reviews.complexity: O(n log log n) with sieve

reviews.solution_rationale: Havel-Hakimi repeatedly connects highest remaining degree vertex to next-highest degrees; reject infeasible counts and restore heap entries after batch.
Need a deterministic multiset-preserving construction separating all row and column sums. Full constructive invariant not yet verified; random swaps alone are not publication-quality rationale.
Multi-source BFS retaining two best distances from distinct shop origins; each city selects the nearest origin unequal to itself.
Degrees are one plus code frequencies. Repeatedly attach the smallest degree-one label to next code value using a min-heap; connect final leaves.
Preorder first item is root; inverse inorder positions split subtrees. Recursively/iteratively reconstruct postorder without repeated copying.
Prioritizing earliest position of low labels differs from lexicographically smallest schedule. Remove largest available sink in reverse topological order, then reverse result.
Orient every edge from lower label to higher label; labels strictly increase on directed paths.
Strong orientation exists exactly for connected bridgeless graphs. Orient DFS tree edges outward and back edges toward ancestors; lowlinks detect impossibility.
Each connected component needs even edge count. Orient back edges, then choose each parent-edge direction bottom-up to repair child's outdegree parity.
BFS from every vertex; non-tree edges propose cycle lengths dist[u]+dist[v]+1, with parent-edge exclusion.
BFS on (vertex,parity) from each source yields shortest walks of both parities. Any extra even steps can traverse an edge back and forth.
Sort tree edges by decreasing speed; joining components contributes speed*sizeA*sizeB to all newly connected pairs.
Kruskal weight groups: edge can appear iff endpoints are different components before merging any edge of its weight.
Build an MST and preprocess path maximum edge by LCA lifting; forced edge cost is MSTcost+w-maxOnPath.
Process deletions offline backward as additions; DSU tracks component counts after each reverse event.
Multi-source BFS computes nearest-coin distance at each node. Query answer is dist(a,b)+2*minimum nearest-coin distance along path(a,b), using binary-lift path minima.

Prune coin-free leaves to obtain coin Steiner subtree. For each query, add branches attaching a,b to this subtree; minimum walk is twice size of augmented subtree minus dist(a,b). LCA computes shared branch overlap.
reviews.complexity: O((n+q) log n), branch-overlap formula needs independent checking

reviews.solution_rationale: Canonicalize each rooted subtree by its sorted child-type multiset, using a shared interning map across both trees.
Find one or two centers/centroids invariant under isomorphism; compare rooted canonical encodings across valid root choices.
For each weak component of request graph, a DAG can be realized by a topological chain with size-1 edges; a cyclic component needs size edges and is realized by a cycle. Ignore trivial self-requests.
Build directed dominator tree rooted at source; critical vertices are ancestors of destination in that tree. General cycles prevent naive path-count DAG assumptions.
Dijkstra isolates edges on shortest paths, forming a DAG due to positive weights; exact DAG dominators or topological bypass-interval analysis identifies mandatory vertices.
Subset DP partitions vertices into independent sets; enumerate independent submasks and store choices to reconstruct an optimal coloring.
Create a virtual vertex per bus company; city-to-company edges cost ticket price and company-to-city edges cost zero. Dijkstra avoids quadratic cliques.

DAG minimum path cover reduces to bipartite maximum matching; target matching size n-2, with reconstruction. At 2e5 nodes, generic augment-one matching is infeasible; specialized two-path DP or efficient matching needs runtime verification.
Collect leaves in DFS order and pair across opposite halves so every tree-edge cut is crossed; ceil(leaves/2) additions are both necessary and sufficient.
Select deepest remaining feasible vertices greedily; maintain nearest selected distance with centroid decomposition and reject distance<d. Exchange proof is crucial.
reviews.complexity: O(n log^2 n) with distance queries

reviews.solution_rationale: Largest monochromatic square ending at a cell is one plus minimum of three neighboring DP states when their letters match; add its size to that letter's count.

For each letter compute largest square ending here that avoids that letter using binary-square DP. Maximum avoiding size over letters is the largest invalid square; subtract from available side length.
Fix top/bottom rows and compress each column into letter counts; a sliding horizontal window finds minimum right boundary containing every letter and counts extensions.
reviews.complexity: O(k n^3) straightforward; optimized bit/count updates need runtime checking

reviews.solution_rationale: Along each diagonal, top-left corners have expiration from min(right-run,down-run); bottom-right corners query active starts within min(up-run,left-run). Fenwick active-start counts give square borders.
reviews.complexity: O(n^2 log n), implementation constants require review

reviews.solution_rationale: Fix top/bottom rows. Within runs where top and bottom match one letter, count pairs of columns whose vertical segment is also entirely that letter; handle width/height one separately.
Choose tied positions, then count fixed-point-free permutations by excedance count via inclusion-exclusion over fixed points and Eulerian numbers. Multiply by n! for first-player ordering.
Interval DP pairs first character with an equal character at an odd offset; multiply internal and remaining deletion counts with a binomial interleaving factor.
Permutation inversion DP inserts largest element with 0..n-1 new inversions; prefix-sum transition reduces each state to O(1).
Separate square colors; diagonal-length DP counts nonattacking placements in each color, then convolve counts to total k. Reject k beyond maximum bishops.
Inclusion-exclusion on missing symbols sums (-1)^i choose(k,i)(k-i)^n.
Sort traps and destination by coordinates; combinatorial path counts subtract paths whose first forbidden point is an earlier trap.
Insertion DP tracks forbidden adjacent consecutive-value pairs and whether the largest pair is adjacent; transitions classify insertion that creates/breaks bad adjacency.
Inclusion-exclusion glues consecutive equal copies into blocks. Convolve per-character coefficients choose(freq-1,blocks-1)/blocks!, then multiply by total-block factorial with alternating signs.
Tournament SCC condensation is a total order. Count strongly connected tournaments by subtracting choices of unique source SCC, then DP ordered SCC sizes with binomial label choices.
Choose cyclic vertices, use unsigned Stirling numbers of first kind for k cycles, and attach remaining vertices as rooted forests via generalized Cayley count.
Greedily consume complete alphabets; each completed block forces one character of an absent subsequence, then append a missing letter from final partial block.
When scanning position i, its value adds i-last[value] to distinct-suffix sum; accumulate that sum over all right endpoints.
Maintain earliest valid distinct suffix; DP for splits sums previous dp states over valid final-segment starts, using prefix sums.
BFS over 9! permutations with adjacency swaps; compact permutation ranking or packed states bounds memory.
Lexicographic greedy needs a completion-feasibility argument for bounded-degree forbidden-adjacency graph and exact handling of short suffixes; plain smallest-valid choice can dead-end.
Binary search median value; count <=mid as sum min(n,floor(mid/i)) and compare to (n^2+1)/2.
Stable-sort indexed values; maximum displacement from original position to sorted position equals productive bubble passes, with sorted array requiring zero.
Maintain a min-heap of next k+1 values: smallest reaches next output position after k passes; once input exhausted, emit remaining heap in sorted order. Cap k at n.
Four signed coordinate sweeps use Fenwick maxima of x+y among reserved points dominated in each quadrant; minimum across quadrants gives nearest distance, then maximize over free points.
Four quadrant sweeps compute nearest reserved Manhattan distance for each free point via prefix maxima; preserve original query ordering.
Monotone stack determines nearest strictly smaller boundaries; each bar's height times maximal width is a rectangle candidate.
Track vector of prefix character counts relative to one character present in the full string; equal vectors delimit balanced substrings. Exact vector keys avoid randomized collisions.
reviews.complexity: O(26n log n) with ordered vector keys

reviews.solution_rationale: Prime factors separate independently. For each exponent e, adjacent exponents cannot both be below e; a 2-state weighted transition (top exponent or e lower choices) is exponentiated to length n.
Represent prime-exponent parities as bit vectors; GF(2) rank r gives 2^(n-r) zero-product-parity subsets, including empty.
Prefix-sum variables form weighted equality edges P[r]-P[l-1]=s. Traverse each component assigning potentials and reject inconsistent cycles; adjacent differences yield array.
Dijkstra on container contents with each legal operation weighted by moved volume; store predecessors and select cheapest state with A=x. Only boundary states are reachable.
Water-jug reachability requires x<=a and gcd(a,b) dividing x.
Signed coin counts on suffixes characterize dominance for every strictly increasing positive weight sequence. Range-add prefix/suffix balance segment tree tracks global min/max after each insertion.
Prefix-sum points form a lower convex hull; maximum average ending at i is maximum slope to current point. Binary-search tangent and preserve earliest start on ties.
Subtract target average from each value; count zero-sum subsets by offset-sum DP and subtract empty subset.
Binary search candidate average; independently maximize transformed prefix sums in both arrays and check whether their sum is nonnegative. Retain maximizing prefix indices.
Remove values from smallest upward, placing each at nearer current endpoint. Fenwick alive counts give swap distance left/right.
Map shared values to positions in first permutation; LIS of those positions in second permutation gives LCS, with predecessor reconstruction.
Segment tree stores boundary bits, run prefixes/suffixes, and longest run; merge crossing equal-bit runs after each point toggle.
Binary search final integer; positional digit-count formula counts each decimal digit in 1..limit, correcting leading zeros and capping totals.
Constructively fix target letters using the two-cell gap as a buffer, reserving a constant-size suffix solved by BFS. Must verify move-budget bound and exceptional small configurations.
reviews.complexity: Specialist verification required for complete construction

reviews.solution_rationale: For each row form heights of consecutive empty cells; monotone-stack largest-histogram rectangle yields maximum building area.
Four invariants: inversion count; n minus permutation-cycle count; n minus LIS length; n minus length of largest-value suffix appearing in increasing order.
Duplicate the positive array, use two pointers for farthest valid segment ends, then binary lifting counts greedy segments needed for each cyclic start.
Smallest sums identify a1+a2 and a1+a3; enumerate candidate a2+a3 to derive a1, then repeatedly extract smallest remaining sum and remove all newly implied pair sums.
reviews.complexity: O(n^3 log n) with candidate pruning

reviews.solution_rationale: Unfold coordinates into sawtooth periods 2(n-1),2(m-1). Count border-hit times <=k as floor(k/(n-1))+floor(k/(m-1))-floor(k/lcm(n-1,m-1)); simultaneous corner hit counts once.
Return time is 2*lcm(n-1,m-1). Count distinct folded lattice positions by congruences under sign choices modulo twice gcd; corner and self-intersection multiplicities require proof.
reviews.complexity: Specialist verification required for distinct-cell formula

reviews.solution_rationale: Use infinite-knight distance lower bounds max(ceil(dx/2),ceil((dx+dy)/3)), adjust parity, and handle small exceptional displacements. First-quadrant boundary needs separate verification near origin.
reviews.complexity: Specialist verification required for quadrant boundary exceptions

reviews.solution_rationale: Start with sum of all negatives, sort absolute values, and best-first enumerate additional subset sums with replace-last/add-next heap transitions, retaining multiplicities.

Sorted exact-cardinality subset sums require best-first enumeration of increasing index sequences with duplicate-free successor generation and compact persistent state. Naive k*m storage is infeasible.
reviews.complexity: Specialist verification required for efficient enumeration

reviews.solution_rationale: L1 isotonic regression uses a max-heap: insert each value twice and remove the maximum, adding the removed excess to cost. Convex slope interpretation proves optimality.
Prefix surplus determines edge flows up to a common cycle offset; choose the median prefix surplus to minimize sum absolute flow.
Any permutation cycle is a composition of two disjoint-swap involutions. Sorted needs zero rounds, only 2-cycles need one, longer cycles need two.

Track counts of distinct subsequences ending in each bit; appending replaces one count by total+1. Reverse subtraction/Euclidean trajectories enumerate split counts for target total and minimize string length.
reviews.complexity: O(n log n) candidate arithmetic; runtime/path reconstruction needs checking

reviews.solution_rationale: DSU components must choose together; subset-sum bitset over component sizes, grouping equal sizes with binary splitting for efficiency.
Coin cells form bipartite row-column edges; maximum matching and alternating reachability produce minimum vertex cover by Konig's theorem.
Each cell has exactly two allowed replacement colors, so encode one Boolean variable. Equal-color adjacent choices are forbidden by 2-SAT clauses; SCC assignment reconstructs grid.
Sort applicants by programming-minus-artistic skill. Prefix top-a programming sums and suffix top-b artistic sums from heaps maximize over split points.
Greedy removal of largest digit can be accelerated by digit-block DP tracking prefix maximum digit, suffix state, resulting borrow and operation count. A direct n-step simulation cannot meet 10^18.
reviews.complexity: Specialist verification required for block recurrence/proof

reviews.solution_rationale: Scan columns maintaining row surplus; cancel opposite-sign surpluses vertically whenever possible, then move remaining row surpluses horizontally and add absolute flow.
Zero final difference corresponds to partition into equal-sum subsets. Reconstruct subset-sum half total, then cancel numbers across the two equal-total groups using absolute differences.
reviews.complexity: O(n*sum values) naive; bitset reconstruction required at bound

reviews.solution_rationale: Bipartite flow with source-row capacities a_i, unit row-column edges, and column-sink capacities b_j; inspect used unit edges.
reviews.complexity: Polynomial max flow on 2n+2 vertices, n^2 edges

reviews.solution_rationale: Min-cost bipartite flow uses negative coin costs on unit cell edges and exact row/column demands; recover chosen cells from residual capacities.
Convolve prefix-one-count frequencies with their reverse to obtain positive differences; k=0 separately sums choose(freq,2) to exclude empty/self pairs.
Implicit treap supports locating minimum remaining element and reversing it into next position; subtree minima or parent-rank maintenance keeps operations logarithmic.
Bounded knapsack splits copy counts into powers of two and performs descending 0/1 updates; monotone queues can also remove log-copy factor.
Count values divisible by each d, compute 2^count-1, then subtract counts of strict multiples descending to isolate gcd exactly d.

Sort values; optimal pairs can be chosen adjacent after contractions. Repeatedly select minimum adjacent gap from heap and contract with replacement cost left+right-selected, handling sentinels and stale entries.

Pigeonhole guarantees colliding subset sums, and canceling their intersection gives disjoint equal sums. Random subset sampling has birthday-scale expected work, but deterministic construction/runtime at n=40 needs specialist verification.
Mex grid equals (y-1) XOR (x-1); prove by excluding equal previous row/column values and covering every smaller value using the highest differing bit.
Histogram monotone-stack decomposition attributes each empty rectangle to a unique minimum. Accumulate contributions by height and width using two-dimensional difference/prefix transforms.
reviews.complexity: O(nm) possible; attribution transform requires specialist verification

reviews.solution_rationale: Reverse cutting into Huffman merging: repeatedly combine two shortest pieces and add their sum.
Optimal cuts split each stick into near-equal pieces for a chosen piece count; global range minimization across every total cut budget needs an efficient incremental allocation proof.
Sort skills and DP over processed coders, open teams, and accumulated penalty; advancing skill increases cost by openTeams*delta, with start/join/close/singleton choices.

Two-stack feasibility becomes bipartite coloring of conflicts i<j with suffixMin[j]<a[i]<a[j]. Discover a spanning conflict forest using segment trees to avoid quadratic edges, then simulate to verify.
